purpose: Reuse Client Readiness, Client Delivery/Job Control, independent QA and Delivery Control as the portfolio-wide fulfillment path from commercial_acceptance_v1 to delivered_engagement_v1.

readiness.rule: Production may not begin until every readiness condition is evidenced and client_ready_v1 is accepted.

productionAdapterInterface.rule: A service-specific adapter may create the contracted output only within accepted scope; it may not self-approve QA or deliver externally.

qa.independenceRule: qaReviewerId must differ from producedBy for the reviewed version.
qa.passRule: PASS requires exact artifact version/hash, scope match, required evidence and zero open Critical or Major findings. PASS means eligible for owner delivery approval only.

deliveryApprovalPermit.rule: Permit must match the exact delivery ID, artifact version/hash, recipient and route and must be unexpired.

rules: commercial_acceptance_v1 alone does not establish CLIENT_READY.
Payment verification is separate from money movement and must reference authoritative evidence.
Job Control and Client Delivery may coordinate work but may not self-issue independent QA PASS.
A Production Adapter may not QA or deliver its own output.
Post-QA artifact modification invalidates PASS and requires a new review.
QA PASS does not grant delivery authority.
External delivery requires an exact owner permit and a separate execution boundary.
Unknown delivery outcome fails closed and is never blindly retried.
P3 validation uses only a synthetic production adapter and simulation sink; externalActionsPerformed must remain zero.
delivered_engagement_v1 is emitted only after exact-version approval and a recorded delivery receipt.
Customer Success ownership begins downstream of delivered_engagement_v1.
